articles.title: Accelerate Amazon S3 Replication with automated S3 Batch Operations parallelization
articles.summary: Amazon S3 replication can be accelerated using automated S3 Batch Operations parallelization, migrating petabytes of data efficiently.
articles.detail: This article highlights the challenges of migrating large datasets between storage locations and how Amazon S3 replication can be accelerated using automated S3 Batch Operations parallelization, ensuring data integrity verification and reducing engineering overhead.

articles.title: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure ExpressRoute resiliency guard
articles.summary: Azure ExpressRoute resiliency guard is now available in public preview, enabling specification of gateway configuration for single-homed or multi-homed setups.
articles.detail: This feature allows users to specify whether a gateway is intended for a single-homed or multi-homed configuration, improving the reliability and performance of Azure ExpressRoute connections.

articles.title: [In preview] Public Preview: Migrate from AWS FSx for Windows File Server to Azure Files with Azure Storage Mover
articles.summary: Azure Storage Mover now supports agentless, cloud-to-cloud migration from AWS FSx for Windows File Server (SMB) to Azure Files (SMB), in public preview.
articles.detail: This feature enables users to migrate their Windows file shares off FSx and into Azure Files without deploying or managing a migration agent, simplifying the process of moving data between cloud storage services.

articles.title: Best in Class: Stream PC Games and Study on the Same Laptop With GeForce NOW
articles.summary: GeForce NOW enables cloud gaming, allowing users to play games on everyday laptops, which can also be used for studying.
articles.detail: This article highlights the benefits of cloud gaming with GeForce NOW, which allows users to access high-performance gaming capabilities without the need for a dedicated gaming laptop.

articles.title: Beyond Volume: Countering the Stealth Tactics of Modern DDoS Attacks
articles.summary: Cisco Secure DDoS Edge Protection uses real-time machine learning to detect and mitigate sophisticated DDoS attacks at network edge.
articles.detail: This article discusses the evolution of modern DDoS attacks and how Cisco Secure DDoS Edge Protection can help counter these threats by leveraging real-time machine learning and advanced analytics.

articles.title: SK Hynix is spending $38 billion to build two new chip fabs
articles.summary: SK Hynix is investing $38 billion in building two new chip fabrication plants, strengthening its manufacturing capacity for DRAM and NAND flash products.
articles.detail: This investment will help SK Hynix increase its production capacity and competitiveness in the memory market, responding to growing demand from AI, cloud computing, and other industries.

articles.title: Lumen (LUMN) Extends AWS Push While Its CEO Doubles Down
